facts.statement: Every Thursday the Community Team gathers in a different place in Free Realms to hang out and party as a Community Event.
facts.quote: Every Thursday the Community Team gathers in a different place to hang out and party.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com community news post announcing the '2011 Kick Off Party' Community Event, held at the stage in Snowhill on Server 1 in two sessions for different regions. It describes the Community Team's weekly Thursday meetups in different in-game places. The post's exact date is not shown; it is listed as posted 4 days and 1 hour before the January 10, 2011 capture.
